fact
mcp_run requires explicit session_id and absolute cwd, because one MCP process can serve several conversations.

fact

fact
recall_hints permits two hints per turn; recalled stores term/file pairs to suppress repeated suggestions across turns.

Curated recall hints exclude journals and compaction summaries; explicit recall still searches those mechanical records.
